asset.name: Polygon

score_rationales.institutional: Regulated access includes the 21Shares Polygon ETP (POLY), physically backed POL with Coinbase Custody, BitGo, and Copper on Cboe BZX, plus FINMA-regulated AMINA Bank offering institutional POL custody, trading, and staking with the Polygon Foundation. TradFi integration is tangible: Securitize expanded BlackRock’s tokenized BUIDL fund to Polygon (verified Polygon deployment; Securitize/BlackRock multi-chain expansion), placing Polygon in major institutional tokenization and payments rails alongside Stripe’s USDC integration.
score_rationales.regulatory: EU trajectory is measurably stronger: Polygon’s POL MiCAR whitepaper was notified to the Central Bank of Ireland (8 Dec 2025) and published (16 Jan 2026) under MiCA, with POL admitted to trading on listed EU/EEA venues—explicit protocol-level compliance with a major jurisdiction. The US side remains a drag: the SEC’s Binance complaint (2023) expressly characterized MATIC among alleged crypto asset securities, and there is no approved US spot POL ETF comparable to the BTC/ETH register—so major-market status is split and not settled Stateside.
score_rationales.supply: POLTRACK (dashboard snapshot) shows ~10.52B POL circulating against a ~12.25B expected maximum that can shrink via burns, with 0 POL in scheduled unlocks (full float). ~3.62B POL (~34.45% of circulating) is staked, which materially reduces liquid supply. Fee-driven burns (~12.14M POL in 30d) compete with ongoing mints, but net issuance is still slightly positive (+5.15M POL over 30d), which caps how bullish the setup can be until burns consistently exceed emissions.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: DefiLlama (Polygon chain, May 2026) shows about $1.20B DeFi TVL, roughly 812,900 active addresses and 9.81M transactions in 24h, plus about $3.57B stablecoin market cap and large bridged-asset stock—indicating heavy real usage; DeFi TVL is strong but not at the very top versus the largest L2s, so adoption is high but not leader-tier.
